verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֹּ֖א אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bō ’el- par·‘ōh wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh šal·laḥ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wə·ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go to Pharaoh and tell him that . . . this is what the LORD says Let My people go so that they may worship Me
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Entra a Faraó e dize-lhe: Assim diz Jeová: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me sirva.

verses.original: וְאִם־ מָאֵ֥ן אַתָּ֖ה לְשַׁלֵּ֑חַ הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֗י נֹגֵ֛ף אֶת־ כָּל־ גְּבוּלְךָ֖ בַּֽצְפַרְדְּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- mā·’ên ’at·tāh lə·šal·lê·aḥ hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·ḡêp̄ ’eṯ- kāl- gə·ḇū·lə·ḵā baṣ·p̄ar·də·‘îm
verses.literal: But if you refuse to let them go I will plague your whole country with frogs
verses.literalPt: Se tu recusares deixá-lo ir, eis que eu ferirei com rãs todos os teus termos.

verses.original: וְשָׁרַ֣ץ הַיְאֹר֮ צְפַרְדְּעִים֒ וְעָלוּ֙ וּבָ֣אוּ בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ וּבַחֲדַ֥ר מִשְׁכָּבְךָ֖ וְעַל־ מִטָּתֶ֑ךָ וּבְבֵ֤ית עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וּבְעַמֶּ֔ךָ וּבְתַנּוּרֶ֖יךָ וּבְמִשְׁאֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·raṣ hay·’ōr ṣə·p̄ar·də·‘îm wə·‘ā·lū ū·ḇā·’ū bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā ū·ḇa·ḥă·ḏar miš·kā·ḇə·ḵā wə·‘al- miṭ·ṭā·ṯe·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḇêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ū·ḇə·‘am·me·ḵā ū·ḇə·ṯan·nū·re·ḵā ū·ḇə·miš·’ă·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: The Nile will teem with frogs and they will come into your palace and up to your bedroom . . . and onto your bed into the houses of your officials and your people and into your ovens and kneading bowls
verses.literalPt: O rio produzirá rãs em abundância, que subirão e entrarão em tua casa, e no teu quarto de dormir, e sobre a tua cama, e na casa dos teus servos, e sobre o teu povo, e nos teus fornos, e nas tuas amassadeiras;

verses.original: וּבְכָ֥ה וּֽבְעַמְּךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ יַעֲל֖וּ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵāh ū·ḇə·‘am·mə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ya·‘ă·lū haṣ·p̄ar·də·‘îm
verses.literal: The frogs will come up on you and your people and all your officials
verses.literalPt: as rãs subirão sobre ti, sobre o teu povo e sobre todos os teus servos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֒ אֱמֹ֣ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן נְטֵ֤ה אֶת־ יָדְךָ֙ בְּמַטֶּ֔ךָ עַל־ הַ֨נְּהָרֹ֔ת עַל־ הַיְאֹרִ֖ים וְעַל־ הָאֲגַמִּ֑ים וְהַ֥עַל אֶת־ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn nə·ṭêh ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā bə·maṭ·ṭe·ḵā ‘al- han·nə·hā·rōṯ ‘al- hay·’ō·rîm wə·‘al- hā·’ă·ḡam·mîm wə·ha·‘al ’eṯ- haṣ·p̄ar·də·‘îm ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses Tell . . . Aaron Stretch out your hand with your staff over the rivers and canals . . . and ponds and cause the frogs . . . to come up onto the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Estende a tua mão com a tua vara sobre os rios, sobre os canais e sobre as lagoas e faze subir rãs sobre a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤ט אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל מֵימֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וַתַּ֙עַל֙ הַצְּפַרְדֵּ֔עַ וַתְּכַ֖ס אֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al mê·mê miṣ·rā·yim wat·ta·‘al haṣ·ṣə·p̄ar·dê·a‘ wat·tə·ḵas ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Arão estendeu a mão sobre as águas do Egito; e subiram rãs que cobriram a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵ֥ן הַֽחֲרְטֻמִּ֖ים בְּלָטֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּעֲל֥וּ אֶת־ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên ha·ḥăr·ṭum·mîm bə·lā·ṭê·hem way·ya·‘ă·lū ’eṯ- haṣ·p̄ar·də·‘îm ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: But the magicians did the same thing by their magic arts and they also brought frogs up onto the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: O mesmo fizeram os magos com seus encantamentos e fizeram subir rãs sobre a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֜ה לְמֹשֶׁ֣ה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַעְתִּ֣ירוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְיָסֵר֙ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִמֶּ֖נִּי וּמֵֽעַמִּ֑י וַאֲשַׁלְּחָה֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וְיִזְבְּח֖וּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā p̄ar·‘ōh lə·mō·šeh ū·lə·’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mer ha‘·tî·rū ’el- Yah·weh wə·yā·sêr haṣ·p̄ar·də·‘îm mim·men·nî ū·mê·‘am·mî wa·’ă·šal·lə·ḥāh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wə·yiz·bə·ḥū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away from me and my people Then I will let your people go that they may sacrifice to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Chamou Faraó a Moisés e a Arão e disse: Rogai a Jeová que retire as rãs de mim e do meu povo; e deixarei ir o povo, para que ofereça sacrifícios a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה לְפַרְעֹה֮ הִתְפָּאֵ֣ר עָלַי֒ לְמָתַ֣י׀ אַעְתִּ֣יר לְךָ֗ וְלַעֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וּֽלְעַמְּךָ֔ לְהַכְרִית֙ הַֽצֲפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִמְּךָ֖ וּמִבָּתֶּ֑יךָ רַ֥ק בַּיְאֹ֖ר תִּשָּׁאַֽרְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh lə·p̄ar·‘ōh hiṯ·pā·’êr ‘ā·lay lə·mā·ṯay ’a‘·tîr lə·ḵā wə·la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ū·lə·‘am·mə·ḵā lə·haḵ·rîṯ ha·ṣă·p̄ar·də·‘îm mim·mə·ḵā ū·mib·bāt·te·ḵā raq bay·’ōr tiš·šā·’ar·nāh
verses.literal: Moses said to Pharaoh You may have the honor over me When shall I pray for you and your officials and your people that the frogs except for those . . . in the Nile may be taken away from you and your houses
verses.literalPt: Falou Moisés a Faraó: Digna-te dizer-me quando é que hei de rogar por ti, pelos teus servos e pelo teu povo, para que as rãs sejam retiradas de ti e das tuas casas e fiquem somente no rio.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְמָחָ֑ר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כִּדְבָ֣רְךָ֔ לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע כִּי־ אֵ֖ין כַּיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·mā·ḥār way·yō·mer kiḏ·ḇā·rə·ḵā lə·ma·‘an tê·ḏa‘ kî- ’ên Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: Tomorrow Pharaoh answered May it be as you say Moses replied so that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Seja amanhã, respondeu Faraó. Moisés disse: Seja conforme a tua palavra, para que saibas que não há ninguém como Jeová, nosso Deus.

verses.original: וְסָר֣וּ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֗ים מִמְּךָ֙ וּמִבָּ֣תֶּ֔יךָ וּמֵעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וּמֵעַמֶּ֑ךָ רַ֥ק בַּיְאֹ֖ר תִּשָּׁאַֽרְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·rū haṣ·p̄ar·də·‘îm mim·mə·ḵā ū·mib·bāt·te·ḵā ū·mê·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ū·mê·‘am·me·ḵā raq bay·’ōr tiš·šā·’ar·nāh
verses.literal: The frogs will depart from you and your houses and your officials and your people they will remain only in the Nile
verses.literalPt: Retirar-se-ão as rãs de ti, e das tuas casas, e dos teus servos, e do teu povo; ficarão somente no rio.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן מֵעִ֣ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַיִּצְעַ֤ק מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ דְּבַ֥ר הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֥ם לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn mê·‘im par·‘ōh way·yiṣ·‘aq mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh ‘al- də·ḇar haṣ·p̄ar·də·‘îm ’ă·šer- śām lə·p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: After Moses and Aaron had left . . . Pharaoh Moses cried out to the LORD for help with the frogs that He had brought against Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: Saíram Moisés e Arão da presença de Faraó; e clamou Moisés a Jeová no tocante às rãs que havia trazido sobre Faraó.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיָּמֻ֙תוּ֙ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִ֔ים מִן־ הַבָּתִּ֥ים מִן־ הַחֲצֵרֹ֖ת וּמִן־ הַשָּׂדֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh kiḏ·ḇar mō·šeh way·yā·mu·ṯū haṣ·p̄ar·də·‘îm min- hab·bāt·tîm min- ha·ḥă·ṣê·rōṯ ū·min- haś·śā·ḏōṯ
verses.literal: And the LORD did as Moses requested and the frogs in the houses . . . the courtyards . . . and the fields died
verses.literalPt: Fez Jeová conforme a palavra de Moisés; morreram as rãs das casas, dos pátios e dos campos.

verses.original: וַיִּצְבְּר֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם חֳמָרִ֣ם חֳמָרִ֑ם וַתִּבְאַ֖שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·bə·rū ’ō·ṯām ḥo·mā·rim ḥo·mā·rim wat·tiḇ·’aš hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: They were piled . . . into countless heaps . . . and there was a terrible stench in the land
verses.literalPt: Ajuntaram-nas em montões; e cheirou mal a terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא פַּרְעֹ֗ה כִּ֤י הָֽיְתָה֙ הָֽרְוָחָ֔ה וְהַכְבֵּד֙ אֶת־ לִבּ֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yar par·‘ōh kî hā·yə·ṯāh hā·rə·wā·ḥāh wə·haḵ·bêḏ ’eṯ- lib·bōw wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Pharaoh . . . saw that there was relief, however he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron just as the LORD had said
verses.literalPt: Mas, vendo Faraó que havia descanso, endureceu o seu coração e não os ouviu, como Jeová havia dito.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֒ אֱמֹר֙ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן נְטֵ֣ה אֶֽת־ מַטְּךָ֔ וְהַ֖ךְ אֶת־ עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה לְכִנִּ֖ם בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn nə·ṭêh ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭə·ḵā wə·haḵ ’eṯ- ‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hā·yāh lə·ḵin·nim bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Tell . . . Aaron Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the earth that it may turn into swarms of gnats throughout the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Estende a tua vara e fere o pó da terra, para que se torne em piolhos por toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵ֗ן וַיֵּט֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־ יָד֤וֹ בְמַטֵּ֙הוּ֙ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ וַתְּהִי֙ הַכִּנָּ֔ם בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה כָּל־ עֲפַ֥ר הָאָ֛רֶץ הָיָ֥ה כִנִּ֖ים בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên way·yêṭ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ḇə·maṭ·ṭê·hū way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tə·hî hak·kin·nām bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh kāl- ‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ hā·yāh ḵin·nîm bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: This they did . . . and when Aaron stretched out his hand with his staff and struck the dust of the earth gnats came upon man and beast All the dust of the earth turned into gnats throughout the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Fizeram assim; Arão estendeu a mão com a sua vara e feriu o pó da terra, e houve piolhos nos homens e nas bestas; todo o pó da terra tornou-se em piolhos por toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־ כֵ֨ן הַחַרְטֻמִּ֧ים בְּלָטֵיהֶ֛ם לְהוֹצִ֥יא אֶת־ הַכִּנִּ֖ים וְלֹ֣א יָכֹ֑לוּ וַתְּהִי֙ הַכִּנָּ֔ם בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên ha·ḥar·ṭum·mîm bə·lā·ṭê·hem lə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- hak·kin·nîm wə·lō yā·ḵō·lū wat·tə·hî hak·kin·nām bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: The magicians tried . . . to produce gnats using their magic arts but they could not And the gnats remained on man and beast
verses.literalPt: Fizeram os magos o mesmo com os seus encantamentos para produzirem piolhos, porém não puderam; houve piolhos nos homens e nas bestas.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַֽחַרְטֻמִּים֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִ֑וא וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק לֵב־ פַּרְעֹה֙ וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֣ע אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ha·ḥar·ṭum·mîm ’el- par·‘ōh ’eṣ·ba‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm hî way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq lêḇ- par·‘ōh wə·lō- šā·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is the finger of God the magicians said to Pharaoh But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened and he would not listen to them just as the LORD had said
verses.literalPt: Então, disseram os magos a Faraó: Isso é o dedo de Deus; ficou endurecido o coração de Faraó, que não os ouviu, como Jeová havia dito.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם בַּבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וְהִתְיַצֵּב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה יוֹצֵ֣א הַמָּ֑יְמָה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁלַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh haš·kêm bab·bō·qer wə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh hin·nêh yō·w·ṣê ham·mā·yə·māh wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh šal·laḥ ‘am·mî wə·ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Get up early in the morning and when Pharaoh goes out to the water stand before him and tell him that this is what the LORD says Let My people go so that they may worship Me
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Levanta-te de manhã cedo, apresenta-te diante de Faraó (eis que ele sairá às águas) e dize-lhe: Assim diz Jeová: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me sirva.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ אֵינְךָ֮ מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ אֶת־ עַמִּי֒ הִנְנִי֩ מַשְׁלִ֨יחַ בְּךָ֜ וּבַעֲבָדֶ֧יךָ וּֽבְעַמְּךָ֛ וּבְבָתֶּ֖יךָ אֶת־ הֶעָרֹ֑ב וּמָ֨לְא֜וּ בָּתֵּ֤י מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶת־ הֶ֣עָרֹ֔ב וְגַ֥ם הָאֲדָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ’ê·nə·ḵā mə·šal·lê·aḥ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî hin·nî maš·lî·aḥ bə·ḵā ū·ḇa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ū·ḇə·‘am·mə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḇāt·te·ḵā ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rōḇ ū·mā·lə·’ū bāt·tê miṣ·ra·yim ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rōḇ wə·ḡam hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- hêm ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: But if you will not let My people . . . go I will send swarms of flies upon you and your officials and your people and your houses The houses of the Egyptians and even the ground where they stand will be full of flies . . .
verses.literalPt: De outra forma, se não deixares ir o meu povo, eis que enviarei enxames de moscas sobre ti, sobre teus servos, sobre o teu povo e nas tuas casas; as casas dos egípcios se encherão de enxames de moscas, bem assim a terra em que eles estiverem.

verses.original: וְהִפְלֵיתִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַמִּי֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יהָ לְבִלְתִּ֥י הֱיֽוֹת־ שָׁ֖ם עָרֹ֑ב לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hip̄·lê·ṯî ḇay·yō·wm ha·hū ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ gō·šen ’ă·šer ‘am·mî ‘ō·mêḏ ‘ā·le·hā lə·ḇil·tî hĕ·yō·wṯ- šām ‘ā·rōḇ lə·ma·‘an tê·ḏa‘ kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: But on that day I will give special treatment to the land of Goshen where My people live . . . no swarms of flies will be found there In this way you will know that I the LORD am in the land
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, separarei a terra de Gósen, em que habita o meu povo, para que nela não haja enxames de moscas; a fim de que saibas que eu sou Jeová no meio da terra.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י פְדֻ֔ת בֵּ֥ין עַמִּ֖י וּבֵ֣ין עַמֶּ֑ךָ לְמָחָ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה הָאֹ֥ת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî p̄ə·ḏuṯ bên ‘am·mî ū·ḇên ‘am·me·ḵā lə·mā·ḥār yih·yeh hā·’ōṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: I will make a distinction between My people . . . and your people This sign will take place tomorrow
verses.literalPt: Farei uma separação entre o meu povo e o teu povo; amanhã, se fará este milagre.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ יְהוָה֙ כֵּ֔ן וַיָּבֹא֙ עָרֹ֣ב כָּבֵ֔ד בֵּ֥יתָה פַרְעֹ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית עֲבָדָ֑יו וּבְכָל־ אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם תִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֥י הֶעָרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh kên way·yā·ḇō ‘ā·rōḇ kā·ḇêḏ bê·ṯāh p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ū·ḇə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim tiš·šā·ḥêṯ hā·’ā·reṣ mip·pə·nê he·‘ā·rōḇ
verses.literal: And the LORD did so Thick swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh’s palace and into the houses of his officials Throughout Egypt the land was ruined . . . by swarms of flies
verses.literalPt: Assim fez Jeová; entraram grandes enxames de moscas na casa de Faraó e nas casas dos seus servos; e toda a terra do Egito foi arruinada pelos enxames de moscas.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְכ֛וּ זִבְח֥וּ לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā p̄ar·‘ōh ’el- mō·šeh ū·lə·’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mer lə·ḵū ziḇ·ḥū lê·lō·hê·ḵem bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh . . . summoned Moses and Aaron and said Go sacrifice to your God within this land
verses.literalPt: Chamou Faraó a Moisés e a Arão e disse: Ide, oferecei sacrifícios a vosso Deus nesta terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לֹ֤א נָכוֹן֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן כִּ֚י תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מִצְרַ֔יִם נִזְבַּ֖ח לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ הֵ֣ן נִזְבַּ֞ח אֶת־ תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת מִצְרַ֛יִם לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יִסְקְלֻֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh lō nā·ḵō·wn la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kên kî tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ miṣ·ra·yim niz·baḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hên niz·baḥ ’eṯ- tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ miṣ·ra·yim lə·‘ê·nê·hem wə·lō yis·qə·lu·nū
verses.literal: But Moses replied It would not be right to do that because the sacrifices we offer to the LORD our God would be detestable to the Egyptians If we offer sacrifices that are detestable before the Egyptians will they not stone us
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Moisés: Não convém que se faça assim, pois ofereceremos a abominação dos egípcios como sacrifício a Jeová, nosso Deus. Oferecendo nós a abominação dos egípcios diante dos seus olhos, não nos apedrejarão eles?

verses.original: דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים נֵלֵ֖ךְ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְזָבַ֙חְנוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יֹאמַ֥ר אֵלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm nê·lêḵ bam·miḏ·bār wə·zā·ḇaḥ·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ka·’ă·šer yō·mar ’ê·lê·nū
verses.literal: We must make a three-day . . . journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the LORD our God as He commands us . . .
verses.literalPt: Havemos de ir ao deserto caminho de três dias e oferecer sacrifícios a Jeová, nosso Deus, como ele nos ordenar.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֗ה אָנֹכִ֞י אֲשַׁלַּ֤ח אֶתְכֶם֙ וּזְבַחְתֶּ֞ם לַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר רַ֛ק הַרְחֵ֥ק לֹא־ תַרְחִ֖יקוּ לָלֶ֑כֶת הַעְתִּ֖ירוּ בַּעֲדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·šal·laḥ ’eṯ·ḵem ū·zə·ḇaḥ·tem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem bam·miḏ·bār raq har·ḥêq lō- ṯar·ḥî·qū lā·le·ḵeṯ ha‘·tî·rū ba·‘ă·ḏî
verses.literal: Pharaoh answered I will let you go and sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness but you must not go very far . . . Now pray for me
verses.literalPt: Faraó disse: Eu vos deixarei ir, para que ofereçais sacrifícios a Jeová, vosso Deus, no deserto; somente não ireis muito longe; rogai por mim.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י יוֹצֵ֤א מֵֽעִמָּךְ֙ וְהַעְתַּרְתִּ֣י אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְסָ֣ר הֶעָרֹ֗ב מִפַּרְעֹ֛ה מֵעֲבָדָ֥יו וּמֵעַמּ֖וֹ מָחָ֑ר רַ֗ק אַל־ יֹסֵ֤ף פַּרְעֹה֙ הָתֵ֔ל לְבִלְתִּי֙ שַׁלַּ֣ח אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם לִזְבֹּ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî yō·w·ṣê mê·‘im·māḵ wə·ha‘·tar·tî ’el- Yah·weh wə·sār he·‘ā·rōḇ mip·par·‘ōh mê·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ū·mê·‘am·mōw mā·ḥār raq ’al- yō·sêp̄ par·‘ōh hā·ṯêl lə·ḇil·tî šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām liz·bō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: As soon as I leave you . . . Moses . . . said I will pray to the LORD so that tomorrow the swarms of flies will depart from Pharaoh and his officials and his people But Pharaoh must not act deceitfully again by refusing to let the people go and sacrifice to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Moisés: Eis que vou sair da tua presença e rogarei a Jeová que amanhã os enxames de moscas se apartem de Faraó, dos seus servos e do seu povo; somente não torne mais Faraó a proceder dolosamente em não deixar ir o povo para oferecer sacrifícios a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א מֹשֶׁ֖ה מֵעִ֣ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַיֶּעְתַּ֖ר אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê mō·šeh mê·‘im par·‘ōh way·ye‘·tar ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Moses . . . left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Tendo Moisés saído da presença de Faraó, fez as suas rogativas a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ יְהוָה֙ כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיָּ֙סַר֙ הֶעָרֹ֔ב מִפַּרְעֹ֖ה מֵעֲבָדָ֣יו וּמֵעַמּ֑וֹ לֹ֥א נִשְׁאַ֖ר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh kiḏ·ḇar mō·šeh way·yā·sar he·‘ā·rōḇ mip·par·‘ōh mê·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ū·mê·‘am·mōw lō niš·’ar ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: and the LORD did as Moses requested He removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh and his officials and his people not one fly remained
verses.literalPt: Fez Jeová conforme a palavra de Moisés; apartou os enxames de moscas de Faraó, dos seus servos e do seu povo; não ficou nem sequer uma.

verses.original: וַיַּכְבֵּ֤ד פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶת־ לִבּ֔וֹ גַּ֖ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַזֹּ֑את וְלֹ֥א שִׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־ הָעָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ·bêḏ par·‘ōh ’eṯ- lib·bōw gam bap·pa·‘am haz·zōṯ wə·lō šil·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: But Pharaoh hardened his heart this time as well and he would not let the people go
verses.literalPt: Endureceu Faraó ainda esta vez o seu coração, e não deixou ir o povo.
